current_answer: AWS Activate terms permit eligible credits to offset third-party foundation-model charges on Amazon Bedrock, including some AWS Marketplace spend. That is not proof that a particular awarded credit covers a particular model. Before use, check Billing > Credits for applicable products, expiry and application history, then verify a small model charge. Google ordinary startup Cloud credits exclude third-party Model Garden models; a separate partner-model perk may be available to qualifying Scale members. NLnet still lists 3 November at 12:00 CET; Interledger Local Impact remains paused.

catalogue_card.question: Will AWS Activate credits pay for Claude on Bedrock?
catalogue_card.text: AWS terms allow eligible credits for third-party Bedrock model charges, but do not prove your awarded credit covers a particular model. Check Applicable products and Application history in AWS Billing before substantial use.

summary: AWS Activate terms allow eligible credits to offset third-party Bedrock model spend, but each awarded credit has its own applicable products and expiry.
Check AWS Billing > Credits and application history before scaling a model workload; provider-level wording alone cannot verify a bill.
Google ordinary startup Cloud credits exclude third-party models; NLnet’s 3 November form remains live and Interledger Local Impact remains paused.
uncertainty: AWS does not publish a complete public model-SKU or credit-configuration coverage matrix; one unverified applicant report describes uncovered Claude charges.
Account-specific credit allocation, expiry and country coverage remain unknown.
Google does not guarantee every Scale member a separate partner-model credit.
